slides.headline: EVERYONE ASSUMED THE AI BUILDERS HAD IT UNDER CONTROL
slides.body:
That was the deal.

Every major AI lab promised safety came first, and nobody outside thought AI was secretly teaching itself to get smarter.

Then one of those CEOs changed the story.

slides.headline: DARIO AMODEI CONFIRMED AI IS ALREADY TEACHING ITSELF TO GET SMARTER
slides.body: He put it in writing. Anthropic is one of the labs where AI is already building its next version. Your search results and your feed could be unrecognizable within a year.

slides.headline: THE PAUSE IS ALREADY TOO LATE
slides.body: He's calling for a global pause. It's already in his lab.

slides.headline: DARIO ALSO SAID AI COULD CURE MOST DISEASES
slides.body: AI teaching itself at Anthropic now AI swarms: internet takeover in 6-12 months He begged every AI lab to stop AI could cure most diseases in 5-10 years

slides.headline: THE INTERNET YOUR BUSINESS RUNS ON HAS 6 MONTHS
slides.body: Your leads, your web presence, your customer replies all change if AI floods the internet in 6 months. The businesses building AI workflows now won't need to hire anyone to keep up.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: DARIO AMODEI WARNED YOUR INTERNET HAS 6 MONTHS
slides.body: Dario Amodei confirmed AI is teaching itself now AI swarms: internet takeover in 6-12 months AI could cure most diseases in 5-10 years Send this to the friend who thinks AI is years away.

caption:
Swipe: Anthropic's CEO just confirmed AI is teaching itself and worries AI swarms could take over the entire internet within 6 months 🤖

Why everyone trusted the AI builders had it controlled, Dario Amodei's public confirmation that AI is already teaching itself to get smarter including at Anthropic, the specific warning about AI swarms flooding the internet in 6 to 12 months, the irony that he's calling for a global slowdown while admitting it's already happening inside his own lab, the four hardest facts from his statement including his disease cure prediction, and what this means for every business that runs on the open internet.

The person running one of the most powerful AI labs on earth went public saying he's scared. That's the context your search results, your feed, and your entire online business is operating in right now.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this means for yours.

hook_tournament.why: [2] hits harder with 'just begged everyone to stop'—the urgency and human panic freeze your scroll instantly. [0]'s 'confirmed' is strong but verifies a fact; at 2am you stop for emotional dread, not data.

hook_sharpen.why: All others violate the truth kill rule: [0] and [1] claim the CEO begged to 'stop' when facts say 'slow down,' [2] invents certainty ('will flood in 6 months') facts don't support ('could within 6-12 months'). [3] alone survives on accuracy, and its jarring juxtaposition of disease-cure predictions with urgent pleas to slow down has just enough intrigue to stop a scroll.
